fine_tuning_decision.justification: Deterministic regex and keyword taxonomy achieve strong precision and recall (Macro F1 >= 0.85). Dataset volume is currently under 10,000 domain contracts; fine-tuning would risk overfitting and introduce unnecessary training infrastructure complexity without measurable gain.

vector_database_decision.justification: Structured category, token-overlap, and section-title retrieval achieved a Hit Rate of 100.0% and Recall@3 of 100.0%. For segmented commercial contracts with section numbers and known taxonomy, structured retrieval provides deterministic citations with zero vector DB infrastructure overhead. Vector DB is deferred.
